title: Clover Elsewhere
description: Short descending questions open into longer, rising answers. A four-note memory of Clover Undertow becomes a song in F minor, touched by the bright sixth of Dorian. The hands exchange the opening phrase halfway through; at the end their separate lines gather into a warm D-flat major ninth.
difficulty: Advanced flexible metre and contrary-motion duet
technical_note: Four bars in three give way to four bars in five. Keep the quarter-note pulse continuous at those changes. In the middle return the first four bars pass to the LH two octaves lower; the RH supplies an independent rising line.

performance.note: Allow each short question its own shape, then expand the response without changing the underlying pulse. The middle bass statement remains audible beneath the upper countermelody.

composition_time_source: Recorded when the first score was saved.

audio_reverb.description: Subtle warm room; preserve the clarity of moving voices.
